create.name: Cara Lai
create.bio:
Cara Lai is a meditation teacher, artist and writer living in Hinesburg, Vermont, with her husband and their two small children. Before turning fully to the dharma she worked as a wilderness guide, a social worker and a psychotherapist, and she has spent a large share of her adult life on retreat, including a full year alone in a cabin in Colorado that began in 2020. She is authorised to teach in the Theravada insight lineage through the IMS and Spirit Rock teacher training.

Her teaching is frank, warm and often funny, aimed at making practice feel workable for people with busy, messy lives, especially parents. She leads retreats at IMS and other centres, has taught teen retreats for Inward Bound Mindfulness Education, and records guided meditations for the Ten Percent Happier and Hatch apps. Online she runs small dana-based classes: Meditate Your Face Off, on the basics of Buddhist practice in real life; a short class on generosity; and Parenting as the Path, co-led with Ofosu Jones-Quartey. She shares free meditations, talks and essays through her Substack, and designs the illustrated shirts and mugs in her shop, with all the money raised passed on to Buddhist Global Relief and to Inward Bound Mindfulness.

courses.title: This Living Body Livestream Retreat 2027
courses.description: A week-long silent retreat streamed live from the IMS meditation hall, taught with Devon Hase, on mindfulness of the four great elements (earth, water, fire and wind) as felt in the body. It includes guided meditations, sitting and walking periods and dharma talks; online participants follow along without direct interaction with the teachers.

courses.title: Meditate Your Face Off
courses.description: A 55-minute online class on living the basics of Buddhist practice, with a short talk, a guided sit of twenty to thirty minutes and open discussion. Themes change each week; open to all levels.

courses.title: Generosity Class
courses.description: A light, half-hour online class on dana, the practice of giving that the Buddha often taught before meditation itself.

courses.title: Parenting as the Path
courses.description: A 90-minute online class with Ofosu Jones-Quartey on folding the everyday realities of raising children into a deepening meditation practice. Sessions are recorded for those who cannot attend live.

free_resources.title: Talks and Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of Cara's recorded talks and guided meditations on themes such as desire, doubt, generosity and practising when life feels out of control, plus a short parenting series.

free_resources.title: Cara Lai on Substack
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, talks and essays sent by email, with optional paid support.
